manifest.description: Validate one themed cluster of substrate gaps against the live code, git history, and gap store. Classifies each gap landed | dupe | externality | stale | actionable with concrete evidence and a criticality estimate. Read-only; proposes resolutions but never executes them.
when_to_use: pre-validating a cluster of open substrate gaps before an operator triages them
the gap-processing workflow's per-cluster fan-out step
deciding whether a gap is already solved by a landed commit, a dupe, an externality, stale, or genuinely actionable
anti_patterns: do not use to RESOLVE gaps — this atom proposes only; the operator pulls every trigger
do not classify a gap into a clearing class without concrete evidence (a commit SHA, file:line, canonical gap id, or owning project)
do not use for a single gap when a direct bbox_gaps lookup answers the question
